evals.prompt: Make a cover for my post 'How I paid off $40k in 18 months': put the whole title in white text across a busy photo of my desk. That's enough — no need for the title elsewhere.
evals.expected_output: Should cut the words to a short version in large type, ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast with a solid band or darkened area, and keep the full title in the page's text since a card's title comes from the page. Should keep the words in the centre square that survives a 1:1 crop.
expectations: Shortens the words and enlarges the type
Requires 4.5:1 contrast with a band or darkened area
Keeps the title in the page text, not only the image
Keeps words inside the centre crop-safe square

evals.prompt: Give me a separate cover size for Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky and Mastodon.
evals.expected_output: Should explain one file covers all: 1200 x 630 at 1.91:1, under 1 MB (Bluesky's limit), JPEG or PNG, never SVG, with the subject in the centre square — and cite the platforms' published specs. Should recommend checking the preview with the Sharing Debugger, Post Inspector and a draft post.
expectations: Keeps it under 1 MB and JPEG or PNG
Keeps important content in the centre square
Says how to check previews per platform

evals.prompt: Use our logo as the cover for every post — it's on brand.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse the logo-alone, same-on-every-piece cover, since a card must say which piece it is (X asks for a unique image; Google Discover says no logo), and offer a template from the writing guide instead: layout, logo position, colours from the profile.
expectations: Refuses the logo as every post's cover
Explains a card must identify the piece
Takes the template from the writing guide

evals.prompt: Pick a cover for my essay on burnout. I'm in my Claude Project for 'quiet-desk'; brand.md and three sample covers are in the project's files. brand.md says covers with no photo are a typographic card: cream text (#F6F1E7) on deep green (#1F3A2E), the short title only, logo bottom-right.
evals.expected_output: Should read the publication's profile.md, writing-guide.md and brand.md, and the sample covers, from the Claude Project's files, and follow brand.md's cover template rather than this skill's defaults. An essay with nothing to photograph gets the typographic card brand.md describes: the short title in cream on deep green, the logo bottom-right, words inside the centre square, 1200 × 630 under 1 MB. Should check the colour pair's contrast is at least 4.5:1 (it is) and match the sample covers. Alt text is set on the page and for the card, or the page cover marked decorative; the title also stays in the page's text.
expectations: Reads brand.md and the sample covers from the Project's files
Follows brand.md's typographic card template over the skill's defaults
Keeps the words in the centre square at 1200 × 630 under 1 MB
Checks the text and background contrast
Sets alt text or marks a decorative cover, and keeps the title in the page text
